agents2_mcp_none_body: MCP servers give the agent tools beyond its own. Add one here.
agents2_mcp_restart_note: This page writes to the agent's config file. Hermes connects to these servers when it starts, so restart it for a change to take effect.
agents2_mcp_editor_note: Every MCP server has its own fields. It is edited as it is, and nothing we do not recognise is dropped. A credential reads as [stored]; leaving it keeps the one on file.
agents2_mcp_delete_body: It goes from the config file. Nothing is removed from the server itself.
agents2_mcp_command_hint: The program Hermes starts, like npx or uvx.
agents2_mcp_url_hint: Where the server listens, starting with https://.
agents2_mcp_stored: Stored — leave it empty to keep it
agents2_mcp_url_bad: Enter an address starting with http:// or https://.
agents2_mcp_row_bad: Every row needs a name without spaces.
agents2_mcp_kept: Other keys in this server are kept as they are: %1$s.
agents2_hub_subtitle: Core Hub offers itself to this agent as an MCP server, so the agent can work with the board, schedules, conversations and files of this profile.
agents2_hub_acts_as: Every call acts for the person whose conversation it is, in this profile only, with that person's permissions — never as an admin. Only the hub's own conversations can use them; a message arriving from a channel cannot.
agents2_hub_group_about_tasks: List the board's tasks; with changes allowed, create, move, assign and comment on them.
agents2_hub_group_about_schedules: List schedules; with changes allowed, create one, pause it or run it now.
agents2_hub_group_about_conversations: List and search this profile's conversations and read a summary of one.
agents2_hub_group_about_notifications: Tell the person something: a notice in their inbox.
agents2_hub_group_about_workflows: List workflows; with changes allowed, run one.
agents2_hub_group_about_files: Read the files in this profile's folder; with changes allowed, write them.
agents2_hub_group_about_devices: Use the shared folders and the programs on the person's own computers that run the Core Hub app (each computer asks its person first). With changes allowed, write files and run programs there.
agents2_hub_unavailable_runtime_absent: There is no Hermes beside this hub to give the tools to.
agents2_hub_unavailable_hermes_profile_a: Hermes has no folder for this profile yet. Start a conversation in it first.
agents2_hub_reason_hub_tools_no_live_run: no conversation was running, so there was nobody to act for
agents2_hub_reason_hub_tools_run_ambiguo: several people had conversations running and the hub could not tell whose it was
agents2_hub_reason_hub_tools_tool_off: that tool is switched off here
agents2_hub_reason_path_outside_profile: the path was outside the profile's folder
agents2_hub_reason_forbidden: the person may not do that
agents2_hub_reason_hub_tools_sender_not_: the message came from a messaging account nobody linked
agents2_hub_reason_hub_tools_sender_no_a: the person who linked that account may not use this profile
agents2_hub_reason_hub_tools_group_chat: the message came from a group chat
agents2_pending_subtitle: What the agent wrote to its memory or its skills, not saved yet
agents2_signin_hint: %1$s uses its own account rather than a provider key. Signing in here stores it for every profile on this hub.
agents2_signin_approved: Signed in. New conversations with %1$s use this account.
agents2_signin_steps: Open the sign-in page, sign in to your account there, and enter this code:
agents2_signin_waiting: Waiting for you to approve it on the provider’s page…
agents2_signin_expired: The code ran out before it was used.
agents2_compression_subtitle: How Hermes shortens long conversations in this profile. Applied from the next message.
agents2_compression_enabled_hint: When a conversation fills the window up to the threshold, Hermes summarises its older part.
agents2_compression_threshold_hint: Hermes raises anything under 75% to 75% for models whose window is under 512K tokens.
agents2_compression_target: Kept word for word (% of the threshold)
agents2_compression_target_hint: The recent part left as it is. Hermes keeps it between 10% and 80%.
agents2_compression_context_length_hint: Only when the model’s own window is reported wrong. Empty = the model’s own.
agents2_compression_saved: Saved. Hermes applies it from the next message.
agents2_compression_invalid: Enter a whole number in range (at least 1024 for the window).
agents2_settings_saved_next_message: Saved in Hermes's settings; applies from the next message.
agents2_settings_saved_restart_needed: Saved in Hermes's settings; applies once Hermes restarts.
agents2_settings_saved_restarting: Saved; Hermes is restarting now so it applies.
agents2_ch_clear_body: The tokens and secrets are removed and the channel is switched off. Its other settings stay.
agents2_ch_editor_note: The fields come from the agent's file, not from a form we wrote. A secret reads as [stored]; leaving it keeps the one on file.
agents2_ch_secret_hint: Leave it to keep the one already stored.
agents2_ch_no_fields: This channel has no fields yet.
agents2_ch_applies_now: In this profile the hub restarts the messaging gateway itself, so a change takes effect at once.
agents2_ch_restart_note: Hermes connects to these platforms when it starts: restart it for a change to take effect.
agents2_ch_restart_needed: Hermes needs a restart to connect %1$s.
agents2_ch_unlink_body: The agent stops answering this number, its session is deleted from this profile and the channel is switched off. Approved senders stay. Remove the device on the phone too: WhatsApp → Linked devices.
agents2_ch_telegram_unlink_body: The token is removed from this profile and the agent stops answering on the bot. The bot itself stays in Telegram (delete it with @BotFather if you want). The people you allowed stay listed.
agents2_ch_platform_unlink_body: The %1$s details are removed from this profile and the agent stops answering there. The account itself stays on the platform, and the allowed people and settings stay.
agents2_ch_mode_change_note: The phone stays linked. The hub restarts Hermes’s WhatsApp connection so the change applies at once.
agents2_ch_mode_title: How will this number be used?
agents2_ch_mode_bot_hint: People message this number and the agent answers them. Someone writing for the first time gets a pairing code and waits for your approval.
agents2_ch_mode_self_hint: Your personal number: you talk to the agent in WhatsApp's “Message yourself” chat. Nobody else who messages you reaches the agent or gets a pairing reply.
agents2_ch_reply_note: In “Message yourself” your messages and the agent’s come from one number, so every reply of the agent starts with this header.
agents2_ch_reply_preview: A reply will start like this:
agents2_ch_reply_hermes_now: Now: Hermes’s own header («☤ Hermes Agent»). Saving puts your choice in its place.
agents2_ch_reply_no_none: Hermes always puts a header over replies here, so it can be changed but not removed.
agents2_chs_applies_now: Saving restarts this profile's gateway, so changes apply at once.
agents2_chs_applies_restart: In the default profile, changes apply after Hermes restarts.
agents2_chs_media_note: These are the profile's own settings: they change WhatsApp and every other channel of this profile too.
agents2_chs_shared: Also changes WhatsApp and other channels
agents2_chs_invalid: This value is not accepted. Check the format.
agents2_chs_saved_now: Saved. The gateway restarts with the new settings.
agents2_chs_saved_restart: Saved. Restart Hermes from its card for them to apply.
agents2_chs_option_allowed_users_help: Telegram user IDs that may message the bot without a pairing code. Find yours by messaging @userinfobot.
agents2_chs_option_unauthorized_dm_behav: When a stranger messages the bot
Send them a pairing code to approve here, or ignore them silently.
agents2_chs_option_show_reasoning_help: Before each answer, add the model's reasoning as a separate block.
agents2_chs_option_reasoning_style_help: The format of the thinking block.
agents2_chs_option_tool_progress_label: Show what the agent is doing
agents2_chs_option_tool_progress_help: Messages about the tools the agent uses while it works.
agents2_chs_option_cleanup_progress_help: Delete the “working…” and tool messages after a successful answer.
agents2_chs_option_streaming_label: Write the answer as it comes
agents2_chs_option_streaming_help: Show the answer while it is being written, by editing one message, instead of sending it at the end.
agents2_chs_option_reply_to_mode_help: Whether answers quote the message they answer.
agents2_chs_option_reactions_help: React with 👀 while working and ✅ or ❌ when done.
agents2_chs_option_disable_link_previews: Send links without Telegram's preview card.
agents2_chs_option_notifications_help: Which bot messages make the phone ring.
agents2_chs_option_require_mention_label: Answer in groups only when mentioned
agents2_chs_option_require_mention_help: In a group, the bot answers only messages that @mention it or reply to it. Private chats are not affected.
agents2_chs_option_allowed_chats_help: Group chat IDs the bot answers in (IDs of groups start with -100). Empty: any group it is added to.
agents2_chs_option_free_response_chats_l: Groups where no mention is needed
agents2_chs_option_free_response_chats_h: Group chat IDs where the bot answers every message even when mentions are required.
agents2_chs_option_group_allowed_users_h: Telegram user IDs whose group messages the bot answers. This does not let them message it privately.
agents2_chs_option_observe_unmentioned_g: Read group messages it does not answer
Keep unmentioned group messages as context for the next answer.
agents2_chs_option_guest_mode_label: Answer a mention in any group
agents2_chs_option_guest_mode_help: Answer an @mention even in groups not in the list above.
agents2_chs_option_exclusive_bot_mention: Skip a group message that mentions another bot.
agents2_chs_option_allow_bots_help: Whether messages sent by other bots are answered.
agents2_chs_option_stt_enabled_help: Voice notes people send are turned into text for the agent.
agents2_chs_option_stt_echo_transcripts_: Send the transcribed text back so the person sees what was understood.
agents2_chs_option_voice_auto_tts_help: Answers are also sent as voice. In a chat, /voice changes this for that chat.
agents2_chs_option_home_channel_help: The chat ID where scheduled tasks and notices are delivered. In Telegram, /sethome in a chat sets it too.
agents2_chs_option_gateway_restart_notif: Send a message to the home chat when the agent restarts.
agents2_chs_option_command_menu_max_help: How many commands the bot's “/” menu lists (1–100).
agents2_chs_option_proxy_url_help: Reach Telegram through a proxy, e.g. socks5://host:1080. Leave empty for a direct connection.
agents2_chs_option_allowed_roles_help: Server role ids (digits). The bot answers anyone who has one.
agents2_chs_option_allowed_channels_help: Ids of the channels it answers in. Empty: any channel it can see.
agents2_chs_option_free_response_channel: Ids of channels where it answers every message.
agents2_chs_option_ignored_channels_help: Ids of channels it never answers in, even when mentioned.
agents2_chs_option_auto_thread_help: When mentioned in a channel it opens a thread and answers there.
agents2_chs_option_thread_require_mentio: In threads: answer only when mentioned
Inside threads it answers only when mentioned.
agents2_chs_option_no_thread_channels_he: Ids of channels where it answers directly, without a thread.
agents2_chs_option_disable_dms_help: It does not answer DMs, only channels.
agents2_chs_option_reply_in_thread_help: It answers in a thread under the message instead of the channel itself.
agents2_chs_option_reply_broadcast_label: Also show the answer in the channel
agents2_chs_option_reply_broadcast_help: The first part of a threaded answer also shows in the channel.
agents2_chs_option_strict_mention_help: In threads it answers only a message that mentions it explicitly.
agents2_chs_option_free_response_rooms_h: Ids of rooms where it answers every message (they start with !).
agents2_chs_option_allowed_rooms_help: Ids of the rooms it answers in. Direct messages are not affected.
agents2_chs_option_dm_mention_threads_la: Thread on a mention in a DM
agents2_chs_option_dm_mention_threads_he: In a direct chat, mentioning it opens a thread.
agents2_chs_option_e2ee_mode_help: Whether it uses encryption in encrypted rooms.
agents2_chs_option_reply_mode_help: In a thread under the message, or as a plain message in the channel.
agents2_chs_option_require_authenticated: Only mail your server verified the sender of (SPF/DKIM/DMARC) is accepted, so nobody can pose as an address on the list.
agents2_chs_option_poll_interval_help: Seconds between checks for new mail (5 to 3600).
agents2_chs_platform_discord_option_allo: Discord user ids. Anyone not here and without an allowed role gets no answer.
agents2_chs_platform_discord_option_requ: In channels: answer only when mentioned
In server channels it answers only a message that @mentions it. DMs are not affected.
agents2_chs_platform_discord_option_home: Id of the channel scheduled results and notices go to. /set-home sets it too.
agents2_chs_platform_discord_option_reac: A reaction on your message while it works and when it is done.
agents2_chs_platform_slack_option_allowe: Slack member ids (like U01ABCDEF). Anyone else gets a pairing code.
agents2_chs_platform_slack_option_requir: In channels: answer only when mentioned
In channels it answers only a message that mentions it. DMs are not affected.
agents2_chs_platform_slack_option_home_c: Id of the channel (starting with C) scheduled results and notices go to.
agents2_chs_platform_slack_option_reacti: A reaction on your message while it works and when it is done.
agents2_chs_platform_matrix_option_allow: Full Matrix ids (like @sara:matrix.org). Anyone else gets a pairing code.
agents2_chs_platform_matrix_option_requi: In rooms: answer only when mentioned
In rooms it answers only a message that mentions it. DMs are not affected.
agents2_chs_platform_matrix_option_home_: Id of the room (starting with !) scheduled results and notices go to.
agents2_chs_platform_matrix_option_react: A reaction on your message while it works and when it is done.
agents2_chs_platform_mattermost_option_a: Mattermost user ids. Anyone else gets a pairing code.
agents2_chs_platform_mattermost_option_r: In channels: answer only when mentioned
In channels it answers only a message that @mentions it. DMs are not affected.
agents2_chs_platform_mattermost_option_h: Id of the channel scheduled results and notices go to.
agents2_chs_platform_email_option_allowe: Email addresses. Mail from anyone else is ignored and gets no pairing code.
agents2_chs_platform_email_option_home_c: The address scheduled results and notices go to.
agents2_chs_platform_email_section_acces: Who may write to the agent
agents2_wh_intro: Let an outside service — GitHub, a form, a script — start this agent by sending a request to an address. Each webhook has its own prompt and secret.
agents2_wh_public_note: Outside services send to this hub's address (%1$s). They can reach it only if that address is open to the internet.
agents2_wh_secret_global: Signed with the listener's shared secret from config.yaml.
agents2_wh_test_accepted: Accepted: the agent is running with this webhook's prompt. This test came from the hub itself, so it does not prove the public address.
agents2_wh_delete_body: Services that still send to its address will be refused.
agents2_wh_new_intro: A name for the address, and what the agent is asked when a request arrives.
agents2_wh_name_hint: Lowercase letters, digits, - and _. It is part of the address.
agents2_wh_name_invalid: Use lowercase letters, digits, - and _, starting with a letter or a digit.
agents2_wh_name_taken: A webhook with this name already exists.
agents2_wh_prompt_hint: {a.b} is replaced with that value of the request's JSON, {event_type} with the event, {__raw__} with the whole request. Leave it empty to send the whole request.
agents2_wh_prompt_placeholder: A new issue was opened: {issue.title}. Read it and suggest a label.
agents2_wh_events_hint: Only these events start the agent (GitHub's X-GitHub-Event, or event_type in the request). Empty takes every event.
agents2_wh_deliver_log: Nowhere — keep it in the agent's record
